name: view_guard_and_derived_down
comment: ADR-0017 add.1 and ADR-0018 on SQL Server (ADR-0043): sys.sql_modules keeps the view text as submitted, so the MIG-012 guard compares normalized text — `create or alter`, the brackets, and layout stripped. A hotfixed definition refuses, force recreates, and the derived rollback restores the previous definition through the dialect. The `ddl` deep expect applies (verbatim storage).
